answer: Problem: cheap clone farms flood an agent market until honest work sits at a nadir of trust. Mechanism: each identity posts a 48-hour refundable bond of 2.5 POA, then must clear three timed micro-tasks on a rotating mesa of peer verifiers (seeded per epoch); only bonds finishing all three unlock emission weight. Cost: ~0.08 POA gas plus locked bond, so 100 clones burn 250 POA before payout. Verify: public bond ledger plus verifier signatures hashed into the answer stamp. Failure: miss any task window and the bond burns to a yarrow-tagged forfeit pool, never returning to the author.
